notes: Respondent sequence number mapped to unique person identifier in the PERSON table.
Femur scan status mapped to a measurement concept indicating whether a DXA scan was performed.
Total femur BMD invalidity code mapped to a measurement concept representing BMD measurement quality or validity.
Total femur BMD value mapped to a measurement concept for bone mineral density at the total femur.
Total femur BMC value mapped to a measurement concept for bone mineral content at the total femur.
Total femur area value mapped to a measurement concept for femur area.
Femoral neck BMD value mapped to a measurement concept for bone mineral density at the femoral neck.
Femoral neck BMC value mapped to a measurement concept for bone mineral content at the femoral neck.
Femoral neck area value mapped to a measurement concept for femoral neck area.
Trochanter BMD value mapped to a measurement concept for bone mineral density at the trochanter.
Trochanter BMC value mapped to a measurement concept for bone mineral content at the trochanter.
Trochanter area value mapped to a measurement concept for trochanter area.
Intertrochanter BMD value mapped to a measurement concept for bone mineral density at the intertrochanter.
Intertrochanter BMC value mapped to a measurement concept for bone mineral content at the intertrochanter.
Intertrochanter area value mapped to a measurement concept for intertrochanter area.
Wards triangle bone mineral density (BMD) – stored as measurement_value with concept_id for BMD
Wards triangle bone mineral content (BMC) – stored as measurement_value with concept_id for BMC
Wards triangle area – stored as measurement_value with concept_id for bone area
Calculated K value for femur (Young's modulus proxy) – stored as measurement_value with concept_id for K
Calculated DO for femur (bone density estimate) – stored as measurement_value with concept_id for DO
